Miracle — Cursed Technique Reversal

After mastering reverse cursed technique, you found out your technique reversal, learning about Calamity Marks. Whenever you witness a calamity happening, a yellow marking appears right somewhere on your body, making you gain a Calamity Mark. You can have up to 6 Calamity Marks.

  • Calamity Description

  • Unlucky… Failing makes no one but the person who failed sad. Whenever you or a hostile creature you can see or hear rolls the minimum amount they could on a dice roll, you gain 1 Calamity Mark.

  • Opposite Nobody likes opposite numbers, it just looks ugly.

  • Numbers… Every time you or a hostile creature you can see or hear rolls two different numbers with one being odd and the other being even, you gain 1 Calamity Mark.

  • Trash… Finding free stuff is cool, but only if it’s valuable. Every time you or a hostile creature you can see finds a new item, weapon or armor of at max Uncommon rarity you gain 1 Calamity Mark. This only counts towards cursed tools and magical items.

  • Failing Overcoming hardships is something rare to see in such

  • with Ease… a vile world we live in, so seeing it is truly a miracle. Whenever you or a hostile creature you can see or hear fails in a saving throw, ability check, or attack roll they had advantage on, you gain 1 Calamity Mark. As a reaction to a creature succeeding a roll, you can spend 1 Calamity Marks and 2 cursed energy to roll a d10. After rolling it, subtract it from the roll. If they fail because of your die and it reaches a 1 or lower (counting the natural die with no modifiers), it is considered as if they have rolled a natural 1 and ignores features that avoid natural 1s.
